title: skills(objectstack-data): teach a field group's visibleWhen and requiresFeature in examples-objects.md
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyvF7SP65frVFAYLv7

Filing gate: ① the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #30810 (card #30692). ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3.
Dedupe: `examples-objects requiresFeature` (issue search, open and closed): no card on this file. **New.**
Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md`).

## What is missing

PR #30810 gives a field group `requiresFeature` (from the action key's `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` vocabulary). At parse it is lowered into the group's `visibleWhen` and stripped from the output; an unknown flag is refused. Beside an authored `visibleWhen` the two combine as `(AUTHORED) && GATE`. `sys_organization` uses it to hide Parent Organization and Sort Order on a single-organization deployment (`requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'`).

The Field Groups (MVP) section of `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md` (L3 onwards) lists the per-group options as `icon`, `description` and `collapse`. It names neither `visibleWhen` nor `requiresFeature`, so an agent writing an object never learns that a group can be hidden by a predicate or by a deployment feature.

## Expected

The section names `visibleWhen` (a group-level predicate) and `requiresFeature` (lowered into `visibleWhen`, an unknown flag refused, AND-combined with an authored `visibleWhen`), with one short example. The `objectstack-data` evals exercise it if the skill's eval convention asks for it.

Serial: after PR #30810 lands (the key does not exist on `main` before it).
